df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna(subset=exposures+['recovery_score']).copy()
# steps_k robustness: add steps_k to full model already done p=0.055

X = pd.get_dummies(d['hospital'], prefix='h', drop_first=True).astype(float)
X = pd.concat([d[exposures].reset_index(drop=True), X.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
X = sm.add_constant(X)
m = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'].reset_index(drop=True), X).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("steps_k HC3 p:", m.pvalues['steps_k'], "coef", m.params['steps_k'])
# single exposure steps_k with hospital
X2 = pd.concat([d[['steps_k']].reset_index(drop=True), pd.get_dummies(d['hospital'],prefix='h',drop_first=True).astype(float).reset_index(drop=True)],axis=1)
X2 = sm.add_constant(X2)
m2 = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'].reset_index(drop=True), X2).fit()
print("steps_k single:", m2.params['steps_k'], m2.pvalues['steps_k'])
# correlation of steps_k with others
print(d[exposures].corr()['steps_k'].sort_values())
